# access.MyGrant

<!-- Generated by `pnpm contracts:catalog`. Do not edit. -->

A live node where the signed-in user holds a grant, with its roles there (GET /v1/me/grants).

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Id | `access.MyGrant` |
| Kind | `view` |
| PII | `none` |
| Tenancy scope | `user` |

## Fields

| Field | Required | PII | Description | UI |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `node` | yes | `none` | Node of the grant; it also covers every node below. |  |
| `roles` | yes | `none` | Roles the caller holds at the node (merged over its grants there). |  |

## Relations

_None._
